items.title: Isambard-AI, the UK’s Most Powerful AI Supercomputer, Goes Live
items.summary: The University of Bristol’s Isambard-AI, powered by NVIDIA Grace Hopper Superchips, delivers 21 exaflops of AI performance, making it the fastest system in the U.K. and among the most energy-efficient globally.

items.title: ChatGPT agent System Card
items.summary: ChatGPT agent System Card: OpenAI’s agentic model unites research, browser automation, and code tools with safeguards under the Preparedness Framework.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI发布了ChatGPT Agent系统卡片，详细介绍了其代理模型的技术实现。该模型集成了研究、浏览器自动化及代码执行工具，并严格遵循OpenAI的Preparedness Framework（准备度框架）进行安全管控。系统卡片阐述了代理在处理复杂任务时的决策逻辑、工具调用机制以及针对潜在风险的防御策略，为理解当前主流AI Agent的安全与功能边界提供了权威参考。

items.title: Invideo AI uses OpenAI models to create videos 10x faster
items.summary: Invideo AI uses OpenAI’s GPT-4.1, gpt-image-1, and text-to-speech models to transform creative ideas into professional videos in minutes.
items.summaryZh: Invideo AI宣布全面集成OpenAI的GPT-4.1、gpt-image-1及语音合成模型，通过优化工作流，将视频创作速度提升了10倍。该应用展示了多模态大模型在专业视频制作领域的落地潜力，能够将创意构思在数分钟内转化为高质量视频内容，为内容创作者提供了高效的生产力解决方案。

items.title: OpenAI nonprofit jam
items.summary: At OpenAI, we build tools to help people solve hard problems—including nonprofits working on the frontlines of their communities. The OpenAI Academy is teaming up with the Walton Family Foundation, Emerson Collective, and a network of local nonprofit organizations to host the Nonprofit Jam—a one-day, nationwide event bringing together more than 1,000 nonprofit leaders across 10 locations.

items.title: Five Big Improvements to Gradio MCP Servers
items.summary: 来自原始信息源的最新动态，点击标题查看完整内容。
items.summaryZh: Gradio 5.38.0版本针对MCP（模型上下文协议）服务器进行了重大升级，重点解决了本地文件上传、实时进度通知及OpenAPI规范转换等痛点。通过引入“文件上传”MCP服务器，Agent现在可以直接与本地文件交互，无需手动上传至公网。此外，实时进度流和自动化API映射功能显著降低了开发者构建AI Agent的门槛，进一步推动了MCP协议在AI应用开发中的标准化进程。

aiReview.reasonZh: Gradio对MCP协议的深度支持优化了AI Agent的开发体验，是Agent生态建设的重要基础设施更新。

items.title: Back to The Future: Evaluating AI Agents on Predicting Future Events
items.summary: 来自原始信息源的最新动态，点击标题查看完整内容。
items.summaryZh: 文章探讨了通过预测未来事件来评估AI Agent能力的新范式。相比于基于静态历史数据的传统基准测试，预测未来事件要求模型具备真正的推理与综合能力，且因数据尚未发生而天然免疫数据污染，为评估AGI进展提供了更具挑战性的指标。
